item.title: A Spring Commissioning Primer for Sailboat Owners
item.description: Prepping Your Sailboat for Spring Sailing Season It’s time to get your baby out of mothballs. How you tackle annual spring commissioning tasks is up to you, but it’s an unavoidable part of sailboat ownership. You must budget for it, both in time and money. If you don’t already have a checklist, here’s a primer on where to focus your attention.
